Ding-dong! 

From inside the shower, Mydei heard the muffled ringing of her doorbell. She turned the faucet off, reaching for her pink fluffy towel and dabbing her body dry before putting on her bathrobe. Mydei had moved into her new apartment two weeks ago, and the ancient oven which had followed her from her previous house finally broke down. Now that she had gotten settled into her new job at the hospital as a physiotherapist, she was anticipating her new oven to be delivered this weekend so she could finally resume her baking hobby. For the most part, her life in this new town was quite boring, although she appreciated the new friends she already made at the hospital. 

Mydei stepped out of the bathroom, tying her bathrobe tightly around her waist before heading towards her main door. She peered through the peephole, and saw a white-haired woman outside. The woman, who was wearing a navy polo and cargo pants, was holding a clipboard. There was no oven in sight, so Mydei assumed she was probably promoting something or running a survey. 

The woman shuffled closer to the door, giving Mydei a clearer look at her face. She looked young, probably around Mydei’s age. Another knock resounded as the woman made another attempt. Through the peephole, Mydei caught a small pout appearing on her face at the perceived rejection. She was kind of cute, even through the blurry viewer. Mydei sighed. It must have been way too long since she had gotten laid if she was thinking thoughts like this about a random woman whose face she could not even see clearly.  Hope I don’t regret this, she thought, unlocking her door from the inside and pulling it open. 

“Hi, good morning!” 

A sprightly voice greeted Mydei immediately even before the door was fully open. Like this, she could see the woman properly. The shirt she wore had on a logo which Mydei recognised as the neighbourhood firestation’s, and the blonde fought not to stare at the biceps which bulged right under her tight sleeves. Fluffy white bangs framed blue eyes that widened upon noticing Mydei. She’s hot, Mydei commented in her mind, suddenly feeling more self-conscious in her pink robe. The woman had a dash of freckles on her sun-kissed skin, and a plump lower lip that was currently being chewed on. A tattoo in the shape of a sun decorated her neck.

“Wow oh sorry urm.” The woman ran one hand through her hair nervously. Mydei observed that her hair was tied into a short ponytail at the back. “I’m the fire station from Phai-oh shit sorry I meant! I’m Phainon from the fire station.” 

Phainon’s ears were coloured red, and Mydei did not miss the way her eyes raked down the silhouette of her body in her robe. Feeling bold, she loosened her hold on the robe’s tie, leaning against her door. Her bathrobe opened slightly, exposing the red ink on her chest and the curve of her right breast.

She heard Phainon’s breath hitch, and blue eyes dipped briefly to her chest before they returned to her face. Phainon was staring at her without blinking, as if it took all of her self-control not to look away. Mydei had to resist the urge to smirk, choosing to continue the conversation. “So, how can I help you?” 

“Do you like women?” 

Now it was Mydei’s eyes that widened. She did not expect the woman to be so forward, especially after the shyness she displayed. 

“No! I mean, yes but… Argh what’s wrong with me, let me start again! I’m from the fire station and we are selling our er, calendars for charity,” Phainon spoke sheepishly. “You just moved in recently?” 

“Yeah, I’m new to the neighbourhood,” Mydei replied, offering a small smile. “I’m Mydeimos, but Mydei’s fine too.” 

“Ah I see! Nice to meet you, Mydei. It’s not often we get new people here. Our neighbourhood’s not too big but everyone is pretty friendly!”

A shout was heard from the other end of the corridor. “Hurry up, Phainon! I’ve already finished all of my units!” 

“Okay, almost done Cipher!” Phainon yelled, turning her attention back to Mydei and furrowing her brows in apology. The expression made her look puppy-like. 

“So, what are these calendars?” 

“Oh okay, urm, this is really embarrassing because it’s like a gimmick that all of the residents already know about? And I swear we usually get good support! Well-” 

“Your colleague’s waiting for you,” Mydei teased, sensing Phainon beating around the bush and deciding to push her embarrassment further.

Phainon exhaled. “We have two calendars. One featuring the animals from the animal shelter we are raising funds for,” Phainon showed Mydei the clipboard. On it was a preview of the photoshoot, showcasing adorable animals posed against colourful backgrounds. 

“These photos are cute,” Mydei commented, specifically pointing at a photo of an orange tabby cat glaring at the camera. 

“I know, right? That’s Fig Stew, she’s super cute!” Phainon grinned, eyes sparkling as she appeared to recall memories of the cat. “She took a while to warm up to me, but she’s pretty affectionate.” 

The fondness in Phainon’s voice as she proceeded to introduce the puppy and rabbit in the other photos made Mydei’s heart skip a beat. She was known to be weak for women like this - strong, cheerful, animal-loving… 

“And for the other option, we have this,” Phainon flipped to the next page, voice growing softer. “Urm, us firefighters with the animals.” 

Mydei peered at the selected three photos. One was a group photo, of several women dressed in turnout pants and sports bras. She now understood what Phainon meant by “gimmick”, because the photoshoot was obviously meant to appeal to a certain group of people. 

Phainon was standing in the front in the group photo, laughing as she carried a big Samoyed. One of the other photos also featured Phainon, this time round lying down in a bed of grass with the hard lines of her abs exposed as she swung Fig Stew up in her arms. Mydei was part of that certain group of people, alright. 

“Is there an option where it’s just you?” Mydei asked shamelessly, enjoying the way Phainon’s face turned as red as a tomato. Even her neck was becoming pink, and Mydei found herself curious about how far her blush went. 

“We don’t have that, but I’m really flattered.” The white-haired woman scratched the back of her neck, before tugging at her collar. “I mean, you’re… You’re so…”

Mydei raised an eyebrow at Phainon’s sputtering. They were interrupted by ringing from the firefighter’s pocket. 

“I really have to go now, we have an important training soon,” Phainon apologised. She removed a sheet of paper from her clipboard, handing it to Mydei. “If you’d like to support us, you can mail your order to us or use the website mentioned here!” 

Mydei accepted the form, feeling slightly disappointed that the other woman was already leaving. “Sure, I’ll be happy to support.” 

“Thank you!” Phainon smiled in gratitude. “I hope to see you around a lot, Mydei!” 

“Sure,” Mydei responded, feeling her heart beat faster upon hearing those words. “See you around, Phainon.” 

With that, Phainon sent her one last smile, before she ran down the corridor. Now faced with silence, Mydei closed her door. Her heart was finally slowing down. It seemed like her days in this neighbourhood were about to get interesting.

—----------------------

Mydei was packing up her belongings when the room’s phone rang. 

“Hi Mydei!” Hyacine, one of the hospital doctors and the first friend she made, greeted. “I’m really sorry this is so last minute, but could you see a patient real quick? She sprained her back, it’s not too serious so it shouldn’t take so long!” 

“Okay sure, no problem,” Mydei agreed. Last minute referrals were not unusual in the hospital, and she was definitely ready to help especially if it was Hyacine who sent the patient over. 

“You’re the best! I’ll send her over now and update the patient data!” 

Acknowledging Hyacine’s words, Mydei proceeded to wipe down the bed and place a fresh disposable cover over it to prepare for the session. She quickly went through the list of potential exercises and stretches she could teach the patient.

Just then, she heard a knock on the door. Mydei got up and slid open the door, immediately making eye contact with a familiar face. 

“Mydei! We meet again!” Phainon’s entire face lit up as she stepped into the room. She was wearing the same cargo pants she wore previously, paired with a black tank top that clung to her skin in a way that almost made Mydei jealous. Her white hair was let down this time, ends already curling from the humidity. Mydei watched as Phainon ran her fingers through the fluffy layers to sweep her bangs back. 

“Hi,” she greeted back. “I heard from Dr Hyacine you hurt your back? What happened?”

Phainon sighed, sitting down and wincing from the pain. “I was supposed to be off-duty today… I passed by a shophouse and saw there was smoke coming out from the third floor. Didn’t seem too serious so I thought I could handle it myself. I managed to get the owner out but he was really upset over losing his life savings so I went back in to save his cashbox… Turns out the building was too old! The ladder on the outside broke when I was getting out and that’s how I fell, haha!” 

Mydei frowned in disapproval. “That must have hurt. The landlord should be sued for neglecting to maintain the building. It’s dangerous for anyone.”

“Yeah, I immediately reported it to the mayor.” Phainon shook her head, sighing. 

Humming in acknowledgement, Mydei brought the topic back to her injury. “Could you show me where it hurts?” 

“Yeah, it hurts in my lower back.” Phainon shifted such that her back was facing Mydei. “And! I hurt my shoulder too, because I had to break down the door…” True enough, a massive bruise coloured Phainon’s left shoulder. The skin was still red and swollen, indicating its recency. 

Mydei ran her fingers gently over the area, and the other woman hissed lightly. “Maybe you should have just waited for backup,” the blonde chided softly. 

Phainon laughed in response. “Nah, these injuries are pretty common for us. Just a part of the job.” 

Mydei sighed in exasperation, but she felt herself smile. “Lie down on your stomach, I’ll check your lower back now.” She watched Phainon get up, removing her shoes and climbing onto the bed. Phainon folded her arms and rested her cheek on them, eyes following Mydei’s movements as the physiotherapist pulled on her gloves.

“Wait! I’m allergic to latex, so I’m alright if you touch me without gloves.” 

“Okay.” Mydei removed her gloves, tossing them onto the desk. 

“Besides, I heard from Hyacine that I’m your last patient. And I’m completely well!” 

Mydei’s eyes narrowed. Something felt a little off, but she could not put her finger on it. Anyway.

“I’m going to lift your top and press on your lower back to find the exact pain points. Is that okay?” 

“Yeah, go ahead.” Phainon’s voice was a little breathless, but Mydei thought it might have just been her own imagination. She tugged the hem of Phainon’s tank up, exposing her lower back. Mydei tried not to focus too hard on her defined erectors, tearing her gaze away from the dip in Phainon’s back and starting to press her thumb into the muscle. 

“Does it hurt here?” 

“Nope… Erm, maybe a little to the right, yes ouch!” 

Mydei applied pressure to the area again to make sure. “Here?”

“Yeah…” 

The pain point was about two inches away from the center of Phainon’s back. “Could you try lifting your left leg?” 

Phainon raised her left leg easily. 

“Ah okay, so it should be a minor sprain then. You should be fine soon.” 

The leg that was moving stopped.

“Argh, no it hurts…” 

Mydei gingerly held her leg at the knee, lowering it back down. “You can’t lift your leg beyond that height?” 

“Yeah.”

Noting that down in her head, Mydei instructed Phainon to try lifting her other leg. She was able to raise it without issue, meaning the sprain was localised to her left side. 

“Okay, I see. So I’ll show you some basic stretches. Turn around and lie on your back.”

Phainon obeyed, flipping around and crinkling the disposable cover in the process. The side of her cheek which had been smushed against her arm was now slightly reddened, and her hair was tousled from lying down. Mydei averted her gaze from the endearing sight and pretended to adjust the bed cover. 

“You can do this before bed every night, it should help stretch your lower back.” Mydei led one of Phainon’s hands to the pillow. “Hold onto the pillow like this, then slowly bring your right leg over your body while facing your hand.” Mydei gently folded Phainon’s knee, pushing her leg over slowly. 

“Oof… Yeah I definitely feel the stretch.”

Unable to help herself, Mydei chuckled. “You don’t have to force yourself to stretch all the way for now due to your pain, just enough to relieve the tightness will do.” She continued showing Phainon a few more stretches, but emphasised that the main thing she had to do was avoid strain and lifting heavily. 

Phainon nodded eagerly throughout the whole session, listening attentively. “Okay, that’s all for today. You should be fine soon as long as you don’t worsen the injury,” Mydei reassured, unlocking the computer to check Phainon out.

“So urm, when’s my next appointment?” The white-haired woman asked, knee bouncing in a manner that Mydei could only guess was due to nervousness. 

“Hm, I don’t think you’ll need another-”

“But Mydei, I could fall again! My job is pretty dangerous, y’know.” Phainon jutted out her lower lip pathetically, batting her eyelashes. She looked stupid as hell, but Mydei must have been tired from the work day because a traitorous part of her still found it cute. Professionalism, professionalism! Phainon was her patient now. 

“I’ll give you an open date. You can call the hospital hotline to make an appointment if you need it,” Mydei relented, and Phainon smiled in triumph. Both of them stared at each other in silence, and Mydei’s head spun as she mulled through her options. A huge part of her wanted to see Phainon again, but there was no way she could ask for her number now because it would violate her code of conduct. 

“Okay, guess I’ll see you soon, Mydei,” Phainon broke the silence first, palms clapping her knees loudly as she stood up. “Thank you for today, I’ll do all the stretches you taught me!” 

“Sure, hope you get well soon,” Mydei responded, watching a little wistfully as Phainon sent her a wave and left the room. The quietness that followed after felt disconcerting, but she quickly cleaned down the room and gathered her belongings. Suddenly, the computer lit up with a notification. It signalled a new appointment, and Mydei clicked the box to note the date down. The patient was Phainon. She had made another appointment for the following Thursday.

Fighting a smile, Mydei shook her head and logged off. Either the woman had slipped and fallen right outside the hospital, or being a firefighter meant having unlimited medical benefits.

“Hi, Mydei!” Despite it being early in the day, Phainon was already all cheerful and sunny, and the small room felt a little brighter. She was wearing a fitted blue shirt with cap sleeves that emphasised the curve of her shoulders, and when she passed under the bright clinic lights Mydei thought she could see the shape of her abs through the fabric. Mydei swallowed, closing her eyes and counting to three. Professionalism, professionalism. 

“So, what happened to you? Did you fall again?” 

“Ah no, I just feel like the pain has spread to my hips. They feel really tight now.” Phainon pouted, sitting down onto the designated patient’s chair. 

“Okay I see, can you get onto the bed again so I can check?”

“Pomegranate tarts?” Two delicious-looking, deep-red tarts sat in the box. Mydei was caught by surprise. She did not know many people who enjoyed the taste of pomegranate, and it would be difficult for Phainon to guess her favourite fruit on the first try-

Based on her wallpaper, the firefighter seemed highly extroverted and like somebody who loved to socialise.

She received resigned laughter in response. “Hehe, it was worth a try!” Unable to help herself, Mydei flicked her gently on her thigh before returning to the desk. Phainon joked about how that was inappropriate to do to a patient, but she was beaming as she slid off the bed and got onto her feet.

“Make an open date appointment again?” Phainon asked hopefully. Sighing, Mydei agreed and updated the patient notes. She thanked Phainon again for the tarts and bid her goodbye, eyes trained on her back view up to the point where the clinic door slid closed. Now that the best part of her day was over, Mydei had to face the rest of her work day…

It was finally 7 pm - Mydei had ended up working overtime because of the high number of patients. A number of the patients were first-time visitors, hence she had needed more time to assess their condition. She did not really mind it as she loved her job, and felt fulfilled from seeing patients get better over time. 

Checking her watch, Mydei figured she could drop by the gym. She had recently signed up for the membership upon finding out there was a promotion, and was looking forward to getting her workout routine back on track. They were clapping and cheering, and the ruckus piqued Mydei’s curiosity. She swung her towel over her shoulder, tying her long hair into a ponytail as she approached the crowd.
